browser_test_process_cleanup.detail: Parallel server stopped after SIGINT. The single server retained native Csound signal handling and required SIGTERM; its isolated compiler child was then explicitly terminated. Server, compiler and resource-tracker PIDs were verified absent. This browser harness cleanup is not counted as graceful application-shutdown qualification.

limitations: No 30-minute heavy browser soak: stress workloads exceed the realtime budget and do not qualify.
Leases coordinate one API process; unrelated processes/containers and namespace-hidden ancestors cannot be reserved.
Pending/running memory reservations are conservative diagnostic budgets, not proof for arbitrary assets/preparation.
Tables/SoundFonts/sample assets stay unsupported for partitions; exports keep their existing behavior.
